numeric_changes.source_excerpt: Dario Amodei 在2026年1月《The Adolescence of Technology》中继续讨论短时间内出现强大 AI 的可能，并保留时间可能更远的限定。他设想的是具备广泛专业能力、可大规模复制的系统，不只是一个聊天产品升级。本文把它作为实验室负责人提出的风险情景，不作为“2027年已经得到确认”的事实。其商业利益需要识别，技术论证也不能仅因商业利益就被忽略。[Amodei 原文](https://darioamodei.com/essay/the-adolescence-of-technology)
numeric_changes.english_excerpt: In his January 2026 essay, The Adolescence of Technology, Dario Amodei continued to discuss the possibility of powerful AI emerging quickly, while retaining the qualification that it could take longer. He envisions systems with broad professional capabilities that can be replicated at scale, not simply an upgraded chat product. This text treats it as a risk scenario proposed by a laboratory leader, not confirmation that "2027 is established." His commercial interests need recognition, but the technical argument cannot be dismissed solely because of them. [Amodei's original essay](https://darioamodei.com/essay/the-adolescence-of-technology)

[DeepMind cognitive framework](https://storage.googleapis.com/deepmind-media/DeepMind.com/Blog/measuring-progress-toward-agi/measuring-progress-toward-agi-a-cognitive-framework.pdf)

numeric_changes.source_excerpt: 长任务能力的进展也需要这样读。METR 的50%时间跨度，是根据人类完成任务所需时间拟合出的成功率尺度，不是“AI已能稳定独立工作这么久”。METR 在2026年3月20日说明，修正拟合错误会改变既有结果，任务分布与统计选择也会显著影响估计。因此，时间跨度结果必须连同成功率、样本范围和拟合方法阅读，不能直接改写为若干小时稳定自主工作。[METR 方法与修订](https://metr.org/notes/2026-03-20-impact-of-modelling-assumptions-on-time-horizon-results/)
numeric_changes.english_excerpt: Long-task progress needs the same reading. Time-horizon results must therefore be read with success rates, sample scope and fitting methods, not rewritten directly as hours of reliable autonomous work. It demonstrates a gap between passing tests and engineering acceptance, not an October 2026 model failure rate. numeric_changes.source_excerpt: **前沿训练关注的是系统效率。** 单颗芯片的理论浮点算力只是输入之一。大规模训练还取决于存储带宽、互联、通信算法、编译器、容错、调度、有效利用率与整轮训练能否完成。把某国产芯片说成“H100的70%”，若不说明精度、模型、并行规模、软件栈和功耗，就不足以形成采购或产业判断；用这个百分比再推国家落后几代，更不可靠。
numeric_changes.english_excerpt: **Frontier training concerns system efficiency.** One chip's theoretical floating-point performance is only one input. Large-scale training also depends on memory bandwidth, interconnects, communication algorithms, compilers, fault tolerance, scheduling, effective utilization and completion of the full training run. Calling a domestic chip "70% of an H100" without precision, model, parallel scale, software stack and power consumption is insufficient for procurement or industry judgment. Using that percentage to infer how many generations a country lags is even less reliable.

Announced rescission therefore cannot be written as completed formal repeal, nor can the old three-tier arrangement be carried forward without stating enforcement status. This round reopened the GAO original and spot-checked current provisions synchronized by BIS. That updates the observation date for some clauses but is not verification of the complete EAR amendment history. "No other new rule found" does not mean "all other rules certainly unchanged." Negative free cash flow in Alphabet Q3 and Amazon TTM calls for stricter checks of project recovery and financing uses. Anthropic's quarterly move into operating profit remains important disconfirming evidence, but evidence of IPO effectiveness, pricing or settlement has not yet been obtained. "Diverging recovery pressure" here is a research judgment, not a uniform earnings conclusion for all AI assets.
